Says whether a model is completely loaded, without waiting for it. With [AsyncLoading](AsyncLoading) on, [LoadMesh](LoadMesh) and [LoadAnimMesh](LoadAnimMesh) return an entity right away while the file is parsed on another thread, and this is 1 once the model is built and all of its textures are loaded. Calling it also builds the model when its parsing is done, so a loop that waits for it costs nothing. Without asynchronous loading every entity is ready as soon as it exists, so this is always 1, and it is 1 for every entity that did not come from a model file. Using the entity, for example with [PositionEntity](PositionEntity), [CountChildren](CountChildren) or [RenderWorld](RenderWorld), never needs this call: it waits for the loading by itself.

This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no asynchronous loading.
@param entity  The entity to ask about.
@returns 1 if the entity is loaded, and 0 if it is still loading or does not exist.
